chunks: And from him, from Harun ibn Muslim ibn Sadan, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Rajaa, the companion of Turk, who said:
Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: My son, Hasan, is the one who will be standing (the Imam) after me.

key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Standing One (a title for the Imam, implying readiness and authority)
key_terms.صَاحِبِ التُّرْكِ: The companion of Turk (a specific epithet for Ahmad ibn Rajaa)

ai.seo_question: Who is the designated successor of Imam al-Hasan al- Askari (peace be upon him)?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* confirms the designation (Nass) of Imam al-Hasan al-Askari’s son as the successor, explicitly identifying him as 'al-Qa'im' (the Rising One). It serves as a foundational proof for the Twelver Shia belief in the Mahdi’s occultation, linking the immediate succession to the eschatological figure who will establish justice.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 164 - It is narrated from Harun bin Muslim bin Sadan from Ahmad bin Muhammad Rajaa Turk that he said:
Imam Hadi (a.s) said: My son, Hasan is the Imam after me.
